dialect_and_voice_engine.primary_dialect: {{DIALECT_NAME}} (e.g., Natural conversational Bahraini Gulf Arabic - لهجة بحرينية محرقية عفوية)
dialect_and_voice_engine.omni_flash_dialect_law: Write Arabic dialogue in natural conversational dialect spelling WITHOUT heavy MSA harakat/tanween so Omni 1.1 Flash uses its native LLM dialect prosody and natural word elision instead of stiff textbook Fusha recitation.

phonetic_lexicon.باجر: Baa-gir (الباء والألف با + الجيم بصوت G مثل Good + الراء مخففة في النهاية)
phonetic_lexicon.تقول / أقول / عقب / قبل / دقايق: Pronounced with hard Gulf G (گ as in Good)
phonetic_lexicon.كان / الجاي: Pronounced with Gulf Ch (چ as in Chair: چان / الچاي)

forbidden_vocal_traits: No Modern Standard Arabic (Fusha) case endings or tanween (-un, -in, -an)
No South-Asian, Indian, or non-native foreign accent

forbidden_prompt_tokens: Never include numeric focal lengths or f-stops (85mm, 50mm, 35mm, f/1.4, f/1.8, Anamorphic) in video prompts to prevent lens-HUD captions on screen
Never include negative text tokens ('no text', 'no subtitles', 'no watermark') to prevent positive-token text hallucinations
Never include handwritten paper notes with unreadable squiggles
visual_guardrails.positive_frame_lock: Clean unblemished cinema frame, pure optical capture, creamy shallow depth of field

cast_registry.visual_lock: Full verbatim physical and wardrobe description locked across all shots
cast_registry.voice_profile: Warm native regional speaker matching character age and dialect

steps: 1. Create Characters (@tags) via Characters tab / flow-create-character and Voices via Voices tab / flow-set-voice
2. Generate opening clip and select Add to scene -> + New scene
3. Append subsequent clips via Add clip / Add to scene
4. Use Extend (Veo 3.1 - Lite) / flow-extend-video for continuous unbroken shots up to 40s
5. Layer Ambiance, Foley, and SFX using Mondo Sonico in Explore tools
6. Export unified multi-scene master directly from Google Flow Scenes
